'''Josh Rangel''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Denver DPC invitational]] on 2 September 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM]] and Hyperdrive, according to William Diniega's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2943">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-08-denver-dpc-aka-hayes-u-da-mand2943/ denver-dpc-aka-hayes-u-da-man], DeckTech (William "FredDurst100" Diniega, 8 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-08-denver-dpc-aka-hayes-u-da-mand2943/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
